vo.text: Look at your phone to unlock it.
vo.speak: Look at your phone to unlock it.

vo.text: It is comparing your face with a stored representation.
vo.speak: It is comparing your face with a stored representation.

vo.text: Many phones project a pattern of infrared dots that your eyes cannot see.
vo.speak: Many phones project a pattern of infrared dots that your eyes cannot see.

vo.text: An infrared camera reads how that pattern bends across your face.
vo.speak: An infrared camera reads how that pattern bends across your face.

vo.text: Those distortions become a depth map, describing shape rather than skin color.
vo.speak: Those distortions become a depth map, describing shape rather than skin color.

vo.text: The system converts distinctive shape information into a mathematical face template.
vo.speak: The system converts distinctive shape information into a mathematical face template.

vo.text: It compares the new template with the template created during enrollment.
vo.speak: It compares the new template with the template created during enrollment.

vo.text: If they are close enough, and liveness checks pass, the phone unlocks.
vo.speak: If they are close enough, and liveness checks pass, the phone unlocks.

vo.text: The phone is not simply matching a photograph; it is checking a secure representation of your face.
vo.speak: The phone is not simply matching a photograph; it is checking a secure representation of your face.
